recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It restores the FHIR-16438 distinction in the current active pages without duplicating the _pretty definition or conflicting with later decisions about SearchParameter registry scope.
issue_request: FHIR-16438 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested a clear _pretty parameter definition plus clearer separation between general parameters usable across interactions and search-only/result-control parameters.
initial_application: SVN r14192, represented by git commit 69bc784817a08f775619849c0e5374d09748b179, initially applied the issue by adding the HTTP General parameters table with _format, _pretty, _summary, and _elements and by making search.html mention _format and _pretty as defined for all interactions.
additional_context: Later search-page work, especially the 2022 rewrite and FHIR-32070 cleanup, separated search parameters from result-control parameters but removed the older all-interactions paragraph. FHIR-36879 and the linked Zulip thread confirm that _format and _pretty are HTTP/general parameters rather than SearchParameter resources, so the right current fix is narrative linkage, not computable SearchParameter definitions.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html to link to the general RESTful API parameters instead of saying only _format works for search, removed the _format-only parenthetical from the HTTP header note, and changed the history interaction note to refer to general parameters.
source_changes: source/search.html: changed the search introduction from an _format-only note to a link to the general RESTful API parameters.
source/http.html: removed an _format-only parenthetical from the HTTP Headers note and changed the history interaction note to refer to general parameters.
